_worked_example: PAPER. GDD §19.5's second of three. Also the first rung of the soft-cap telegraph (I3): a run could reach day 730 and end with no prior warning at all. Low stakes, 30 days to answer, and answering it costs nothing — the point is that the player hears the clock, not that they act on it.

tr.title: Sektör Telgrafı · yıllık dosya
tr.body:
Yıllık dosya çıkmış. Seninle aynı yıl kurulan şirketlerin listesi. Çoğunun yanında bir tur, bir satış ya da bir kapanış yazıyor.

Seninkinin yanında ilk gün yazdıkları satır duruyor. Dosya yorum yapmıyor. Sadece sıralıyor.

en.title: Sector Telegraph · the annual file
en.body:
The annual file is out. It lists every company founded the same year as yours. Most have a round, a sale or a closure next to the name.

Next to yours is the line they wrote on day one. The file doesn't comment. It only lists.
en.expire_unanswered: The annual file sat on your desk unread.

_port_note: The arc's opener, not one of its steps. It starts the arc on EITHER branch - read, or expired unread - because the sector moving on is not conditional on the founder reading about it. It starts the arc and never advances it; the arc raises its own steps. Beyond the day, only a signed Series A or the bootstrap milestone keeps it silent: an open gate is not a closed round, and the soft cap warns every run it can end (I3).
